title: Venue occupancy – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Review venue occupancy
hero.lead: Compare matches, trainings and other events by venue and period.

body:
Filter occupancy

Open Venue occupancy. Choose week or season view, the occupancy type and the venues. The week view compares up to four playing areas.

Understand and use entries

Each booking shows time, event, team, event type and playing area. Open it to review the calendar event or edit it when authorised. Current week returns to today; date controls move through time. Print overview prints the selected period and venues.

Resolve missing entries

The view uses existing calendar events. Check event type, date, venue and playing area in the calendar. Do not create a duplicate event only for occupancy.
